semiconductor_relevance: High — TOPPAN specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging solutions, including FC-BGA substrates and glass substrates for high-density applications.
summary: TOPPAN provides a comprehensive range of semiconductor packaging solutions, focusing on advanced technologies such as Flip Chip-Ball Grid Array (FC-BGA) substrates and glass substrates with through-glass vias (TGV). They support the design and production of high-density wiring substrates, catering to the growing demands of automotive and high-end processor markets.
capabilities: FC-BGA substrates with high density wiring
Glass substrates with TGV and varying cavity depths
